allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem . -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "figma|mcp|design" } | Select-Object FullName | Select-Object -First 30)

PowerShell($connection = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3845 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($connection\) { foreach \($conn in $connection\) { if \($conn.OwningProcess -ne 0\) { Stop-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -Force -Confirm:$false; Write-Output "Stopped process with PID $\($conn.OwningProcess\)" } } } else { Write-Output "No active connection on port 3845" })
